acceptance_criteria.description: The launcher sends one authenticated control-v2 shutdown request after checkpoint drain and accepts only a matching Applied/Replayed result; every rejection, mismatch, parse error, EOF, and timeout takes the bounded forced fallback.
A correlated ACK precedes one exact guarded taskkill.exe /PID request against the retained mGBA process identity, with no /F, /T, /IM, shell, PATH lookup, or secret-bearing argument.

One absolute deadline covers ACK, soft close, natural waits, complete Job-tree termination/proof, and sidecar exit; delayed or unrelated events cannot starve it, and every survivor is force-terminated and reaped.

Shutdown reports a typed graceful/forced disposition, preserves idempotent stop behavior, works before Lua connects, and never allows cleanup or lease release until both root handles and the emulator Job tree have certain terminal outcomes.

Tests cover matching/replayed ACK, wrong ID/epoch, rejected/conflict/malformed/EOF/timeout, helper success/nonzero/hang/race, natural and forced dual-child exit, descendant survival, early Ctrl-C, checkpoint drain ordering, failed reap recovery retention, and exact helper argv.
Launcher and Phase-2 smoke tests, formatting, launcher clippy with warnings denied, local smoke, and diff checks pass with changes confined to owned_files.

closed_decisions: This unit starts only after the accepted sidecar control-v2 and Windows mGBA Job-containment patches are consolidated. Do not reimplement or weaken either foundation.

Shutdown ordering is: drain only an already-authorized checkpoint under its existing bound; send one authenticated epoch-bound shutdown_request; require a correlated Applied or exact Replayed command_result; then attempt emulator soft close. The ACK proves only sidecar Quiescing, not save flush or process exit.

A mismatched command ID or epoch, Rejected, Conflict, malformed/oversized line, EOF before ACK, timeout, ledger saturation, or control failure skips the soft-close claim and enters the existing bounded force/retain path.

On Windows, the smallest allowed soft-close request is the already guarded absolute System32 taskkill.exe invoked without a shell and with exactly /PID plus the decimal PID of the still-owned mGBA process. Never pass /F, /T, /IM, user text, paths, or secrets. Retain the original mGBA process handle across the entire PID-based operation so the PID cannot be recycled to another process.

taskkill success means only that a best-effort close request was accepted; it is not a WM_CLOSE, flush, or exit proof. A nonzero taskkill status is not fatal when the exact retained process handle independently proves mGBA exited concurrently.

Use one absolute shutdown deadline across ACK, soft-close helper, natural mGBA wait, Job descendant termination/proof, and natural sidecar exit. Unrelated control events may not extend it. Any survivor or uncertain Job/helper outcome is force-terminated and reaped through the containment supervisor before cleanup can proceed.

After the exact mGBA root exits naturally, explicitly terminate/close the owned Job to remove any surviving descendants and require the supervisor's complete-tree evidence. The quiescing sidecar should then exit on bridge/control EOF. Reap both owned roots before ROM/session cleanup or lease release.

Return a typed shutdown disposition that distinguishes graceful completion from forced fallback without exposing secret material. Preserve idempotent repeated stop calls and retain the lease/recovery SAV whenever either reap is uncertain.
Early Ctrl-C before Lua connects must use the new pre-bridge sidecar shutdown path and remain bounded. Do not require a ROM/Lua shutdown frame or automatic script loading.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit Cargo manifests/lock, sidecar, cloud/server/protocol/save, bridge/Lua, ROM, manifest generator, regional identity data, documentation, or orchestration state outside owned_files.

Do not accept an uncorrelated ACK, soft-close before sidecar quiescence, equate helper success with emulator exit, use /F or /T as the graceful attempt, kill only the mGBA root as the force fallback, or release a lease while any root/descendant outcome is uncertain.

Do not add unsafe Rust, allow attributes, a shell, PATH-resolved system helpers, secrets in argv/environment/logs/errors, unbounded reads/channels/tasks/threads/retries, or per-step deadlines that can exceed the one absolute bound.
Do not change checkpoint semantics, save/recovery retention, mGBA gameplay argv, regional progress/tier rules, or authenticated session fencing.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact Git remotes, create/remove worktrees, or revert edits made by another worker.
objective: Integrate sidecar control v2 with the Job-contained mGBA supervisor so shutdown quiesces authenticated checkpoint traffic, attempts one bounded Qt-friendly close of the exact owned emulator, reaps both complete child lifecycles, and falls back deterministically without releasing the cloud lease early.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and every required verification command has a recorded outcome.
A foundation patch does not expose the required correlated shutdown or complete-tree supervision seam and proceeding would cross owned_files.
A concrete Windows close, process-reap, or lease-ordering blocker prevents safe progress within the execution budget.
